about: Per-service sentence patterns for the facility x service knowledge base. A sentence matches a service when 'include' hits, 'exclude' does not, and (where 'exclude_clause' is set) some clause that carries the include hit has no 'exclude_clause' hit; clauses are split on 'clause_split' (after 'strip_before_match' is removed, icu only). Shared non-offer cues remove a match from positive evidence; weakening cues keep it but mark it qualified. 'quantity' extracts counts or sizes (beds, machines, tesla, slices). Patterns of the 8 cleaning/claims services are copied from cleaning/claims/lexicon.py unchanged; the others are new (lexicon_src.py comments give each exclusion's reason).
regex_flavor: Python re, case-insensitive, one sentence at a time; uses \b and (?!...) lookahead (Java/Spark ok, RE2/DuckDB not).

nonoffer.future: \b(is|are|being) planned|plans? to (start|open|set|launch|add|install)|upcoming|coming soon|\bproposed\b|under construction|will be (installed|started|set up|opened|launched|available|commissioned|added)|to be (started|set up|established|launched|opened|commissioned|installed)|in the pipeline|\bplanned\b|plans? to (establish|build|develop|set up)

weakening.hedge: if applicable|\(if any\)|\bpossibly\b|\blikely\b|\bmay (have|offer|provide|include)\b|presumabl|not (specified|confirmed|clear)|\bunclear\b|as reported by|reportedly|\bappears to\b|\bimplied\b|\bassumed\b|inferred

sentence_kinds.research: \b(multi-?cent\w*|published|journal|cohort|retrospective|prospective|randomi[sz]ed|et al|consortium|cross-sectional|case report|case series|we report|was conducted|were included|patients were|study period|(?:study|trial) (?:was|enrolled|recruited|included|documented|population|site))\b

attribute_scope:
Attribute slots for hours and details (review issue 8): what the KB step must fill per (facility, service) and per
facility. build_lexicon.py copies the schema into services.json ('attributes') and lexicon.json ('attribute_patterns',
'facility_attributes') and counts how often each pattern fires (out/attribute_counts.csv).

Scope rule: a service attribute is read only from a sentence that matched that service (a hospital's 24x7 pharmacy
says nothing about its cath lab). 'from_service' attributes are not text patterns: they are true when the same
facility has positive evidence for the named service (blood_on_site <- blood_bank). Facility attributes are read from
any of the facility's sentences. Patterns are Python re, case-insensitive. A hit is a claim, not a verified fact.
